content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-231. - Legislative declaration.
content.summary:
The city council hereby declares it to be in the interest of the health, safety, and
               welfare of citizens of the city and a proper exercise of the police power to regulate
               those providing security services.
(Code 1981, § 21-91; Ord. No. 3739, § 2, 3-4-2002)
